questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Distributed Systems Characterization, System Architectures & Models
questions.text: Define Distributed System. Explain its goals (Transparency, Scalability, Reliability, Openness). Differentiate between Tightly Coupled vs Loosely Coupled systems.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Distributed Systems Characterization, System Architectures & Models
questions.text: Explain Communication in Distributed Systems: Remote Procedure Call (RPC) execution model, Remote Method Invocation (RMI), and Message-Oriented Middleware (MOM).
Explain Synchronization in Distributed Systems: Lamport's Logical Clocks, Vector Clocks, and Mutual Exclusion Algorithms (Ricart-Agrawala, Maekawa, Token Ring).
Explain Election Algorithms in Distributed Systems: Bully Algorithm and Ring Algorithm with step-by-step failure recovery examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Distributed Consistency, Replication & Consensus Algorithms
questions.text: Explain Cloud Computing Service Models: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS. Explain Cloud Deployment Models: Public, Private, Hybrid, and Community clouds.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Distributed Consistency, Replication & Consensus Algorithms
questions.text: Explain Virtualization in Cloud Computing: Hypervisor Type 1 (Bare-metal) vs Type 2 (Hosted). Compare Virtual Machines (VMs) vs Containerization (Docker and Kubernetes).
Explain Cloud Storage, Big Data Processing using MapReduce framework and Apache Hadoop / Spark architecture. Explain CAP Theorem (Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance).
